name: user/v0.4.1
body:
## What's Changed

* user: prevent possible DoS via unbounded parsing of user and group database files in CVE-2026-61801 / [GHSA-mjcv-p78q-w5fw](https://github.com/moby/sys/security/advisories/GHSA-mjcv-p78q-w5fw). This fixes a similar issue as CVE-2026-47262 in containerd.
* user: prevent falling back to looking up numeric usernames and improve handling of numeric user/group to prevent looking up numeric values as usernames. This fixes a similar issue as CVE-2026-46680 in containerd. https://github.com/moby/sys/pull/221
* user: bump Go to 1.18, modernize https://github.com/moby/sys/pull/198
* user: make code a bit more DRY https://github.com/moby/sys/pull/225
* user: test cleanups https://github.com/moby/sys/pull/226

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/moby/sys/compare/user/v0.4.0...user/v0.4.1
